title: full-send: build an approved plan
description: Routes entry → build → verify → owner → ship → learn. Starts only from the go full-control recorded; without a go, finish this track and start full-control instead.

stages.title: Entry gate
stages.description: Read the MR with the workflow resume playbook. Continue only with a recorded go or in the fast lane of workflow section 5. Choose the shape.
inputs: the draft MR/PR with the owner's go

outputs.name: go
outputs.description: link to the recorded go, or the fast-lane reason

outputs.name: shape
outputs.description: serial slices, parallel lanes or orchestrate, and why

stages.title: Build slices
stages.description: Each slice in the implement-spec loop. Delegates per the routing table in AGENTS.md; a slice is done when its Accept ran green on the real artifact.

outputs.name: slices
outputs.description: per slice: commit, Accept command and its result

outputs.name: decisions
outputs.description: build decisions, each marked owner intent or builder default

gate.name: accept
gate.description: every slice's Accept command run in this visit, with its exit code

stages.title: Verify the whole
stages.description: The workflow verification playbook, review over the whole MR, then one independent review on a different model family. Fixes go back to build.

outputs.name: tests
outputs.description: the full test command and its result

outputs.name: review
outputs.description: findings and how each was resolved

gate.name: tests
gate.description: the full test command run in this visit and its exit code 0

gate.name: reviewer
gate.description: which agent and model reviewed, and the delegation id

next.when: tests are green and the review is clean
a check or the review found real issues

stages.title: Owner gate
stages.description: The human Goldfish round of full-control/references/goldfish.md in build mode, the owner's prediction (limit-cognitive-debt step 5), and the build decisions in two columns: owner intent and builder default.

outputs.name: restatements
outputs.description: owner and Goldfish restatements, and how each divergence was sorted

outputs.name: prediction
outputs.description: the owner's prediction and what the real run showed

gate.label: when a goal is linked: its auditor approved it

gate.prompt: Does the build match your intent, and may it ship?

next.when: a divergence needs a code change

stages.title: Ship
stages.description: The workflow ship playbook. Mark the MR ready; merge only on the owner's word. Publishing, deleting and force pushes stay with the owner.

outputs.name: mr_state
outputs.description: ready or merged, with the link

stages.title: Learn and pick the next
stages.description: What the merged MR taught. Reread the backlog issues: close what is moot, reword what changed, add what was learned. The owner picks the next issue or stops; the next MR is planned with full-control.

outputs.name: learned
outputs.description: what the build or the owner's run showed that the plan did not know

outputs.name: backlog
outputs.description: issues closed, reworded or added, with links

outputs.name: next
outputs.description: the issue the owner picked, or stop

gate.prompt: Is this what we learned, and which issue is next (or stop)?
